name: fractal-cap-design
description: Redesign constrained workflows without weakening their necessary boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Repair constrained workflows without weakening boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Fractal Cap Design finds workflow-level friction created around a necessary constraint, preserves the constraint, and improves completion, recovery, handoff, or continuity. Use it for Review, Redesign, or authorized Implement work; do not use it for purely aesthetic critique or isolated defects without a broader workflow obstruction.
defaultPrompt: Review this blocked handoff without changing it.
